title: Access and Work with Uppsala Conflict Data Program Data
text: ucdpR toolkit reproducible research data Uppsala Conflict Data Program. provides consistent R interface finding, downloading, importing, documenting, comparing UCDP datasets. Downloading data foundation, package designed grow around wider tasks applied researchers repeatedly encounter working UCDP data. package currently helps researchers: discover available datasets without hard-coding download URLs; download directly import current historical releases; pin exact versions reproducible research; preserve source URLs, versions, retrieval details, file checksums; retrieve official codebooks dataset citation guidance; validate common identifiers, dates, fatality estimates, coordinates, codes; audit retrospective changes two releases. catalog read official download center run time, new UCDP releases generally require package update. ucdpR bundle redistribute UCDP data.

title: Access and Work with Uppsala Conflict Data Program Data
text: reproducible research, specify version explicitly record returned filename, source metadata, checksum. Imported objects retain details ucdp_source attribute. Cite dataset requested UCDP avoid silently replacing frozen research data. ucdp_cite("ged") retrieves current citation guidance.
code: library(ucdpR)  # See all current downloadable data files catalog <- ucdp_catalog()  # Search without remembering exact titles ucdp_search("georeferenced|candidate", catalog)  # Download a reproducible local copy path <- ucdp_download("ged", format = "csv", dest_dir = "data-raw")  # Or download and import it directly ged <- ucdp_get("ged", format = "csv")  # Inspect and download a frozen historical release ucdp_versions("ged", format = "csv") ged_24 <- ucdp_get("ged", version = "24.1", format = "csv")  # Monthly Candidate releases can be pinned in the same way candidate <- ucdp_get("candidate", version = "25.0.12", format = "csv")  # Select a specific file when a dataset has multiple variants brd <- ucdp_get("brd", variant = "dyadic", format = "csv")
